name: motive-mem
description: After every turn, a separate model reviews what changed against your repo's .claude/principles.md — intent, principle violations, band-aid fixes — and shows it in a panel

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the panel, status line and review text (en: English, ko: 한국어). Principles files can be in any language.

model.title: Review model
model.description: The model that reviews. opus judges hard cases better and costs more.

effort.title: Review effort
effort.description: How hard the review model thinks.

maxDiffChars.title: Max diff characters per review
maxDiffChars.description: Past this, code files go in first and the rest are listed by name only.

openOnIssue.title: Open the panel on findings
openOnIssue.description: Open the intent review panel when there is a violation, a suspect or a change missing from the report.
